## Download questions

### What are the system requirements?

The Mac app needs macOS 14.4 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. The web app runs in any modern browser, with nothing to install.

### Do I need to install Ona on every device?

No. One account works everywhere: install the Mac app where you take most of your meetings, and use the web app anywhere else. Your meetings, notes and Ask Ona history stay in sync between them.

### Do I need the RecordPen to use Ona?

No, the RecordPen is optional. It's for recording conversations away from a screen, like a walk-and-talk or an in-person meeting. Everything it captures syncs to your account the same as a phone or desktop recording.

### Is there an app for Windows, iPhone or Android?

Not yet. The iPhone app is coming soon to the App Store. On Windows and Android, use Ona in your browser: the web app has your meetings, notes and Ask Ona.
